summary_1line: Abhimanyu devastates Kaurava forces, slays Salya’s brother, and battles many renowned warriors alone while the army recoils from his ferocity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Abhimanyu stands in his chariot at the center of the battlefield, his bow drawn into a blazing circle while golden‑winged arrows fly in every direction.
Salya, pierced by Abhimanyu’s shafts, collapses fainting on the terrace of his chariot as terrified soldiers scatter like deer before a lion.
With a blur of arrows, Abhimanyu severs Salya’s brother’s head and shatters the entire chariot, the warrior’s body falling like a storm‑uprooted hill.
